description: Source file defining a REST API resource for managing 'Rate' entities within the Fineraft project. Contains REST endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and listing rate data, utilizing JAX-RS annotations for HTTP methods and paths, and integrates with security, serialization, and command infrastructure.

classes.name: RateApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for Rate data, providing endpoints to retrieve, create, update, and list rate information, secured with permission checks.

methods.name: retrieveRate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific RateInfoById, with security validation.

methods.name: createRate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new rate, serializing the request and issuing command.

methods.name: getAllRates
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all rates, with permission validation.

methods.name: updateRate
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing rate identified by rateId.
